C

com.irurueta.authserver.bff.infrastructure.session - package com.irurueta.authserver.bff.infrastructure.session
Session persistence adapter of the BFF: the HTTP session stored by Spring Session JDBC in the bff database, and its cookie.
com.irurueta.authserver.bff.infrastructure.session.dev - package com.irurueta.authserver.bff.infrastructure.session.dev
Development-profile wiring of the session store of the BFF: the bff database of the Compose PostgreSQL.
COOKIE_NAME - Static variable in class com.irurueta.authserver.bff.infrastructure.session.SessionConfiguration
Name of the session cookie; the __Host- prefix makes browsers require Secure, Path=/ and no Domain.
cookieSerializer() - Method in class com.irurueta.authserver.bff.infrastructure.session.SessionConfiguration
Builds the serializer of the session cookie: Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, path / and no domain, which is exactly what the __Host- prefix demands (the browser rejects the cookie otherwise).
